summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.170 - Added claude-fable-5 model and the fable alias to SDK model types. https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.170 ## 0.3.169 - Added an experimental `usage_EXPERIMENTAL_MAY_CHANGE_DO_NOT_RELY_ON_THIS_API_YET()` method on `Query` returning structured session cost, plan rate-limit, and local usage-behaviors data - Added an `sse` option (`SSEOptions`) to `BrowserQueryOptions` as an alternative to `websocket`, for browser SDK consumers who prefer Server-Sent Events ## 0.3.168 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.168 ## 0.3.167
type: skills
